== Biography ==
Mary Glasgow was baptised at Barony, Glasgow, on 3 April 1796. The derivative names John Glasgow and Helen Smith as her parents, identified in the current account with [[Glasgow-1348|John Glasgow]] and [[Smith-230548|Helen Smith]]. Her birth day is not recorded.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_690390678&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland parish baptism derivative, Mary Glasgow, Barony, 3 April 1796], inspected 30 October 2026; original uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Parish-register evidence ===
The Barony derivative records Mary's baptism on 3 April 1796 to John Glasgow and Helen Smith. It gives no exact birth day. This is consistent with the existing parental family; the later Mary baptised in 1799 is a distinct recorded event. Mary's possible identification with the later Mary Thomson remains unproved. The derivative may share provenance with the cited FamilySearch entry; it is not an independent witness.

A possible identification concerns Mary Glasgon Thomson. The 9 November 1860 Old Monkland marriage index records Mary Thomson, 37, and William Sneddon, 45, a widowed collier. Her parents are Robert Thomson and Mary Glasgon Thomson; his parents are Robert Sneddon and Mary Gray Sneddon.<ref>Scottish civil marriage index: Mary Thomson; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T1J record]; Extracted marriage index: Old Monkland; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT1H-TBC record]; Indexed father Robert Sneddon; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T16 record]; Indexed mother Mary Gray Sneddon; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TLK-6T1F record].</ref> FamilySearch index inspected after sign-in; original image requires a centre or affiliate library and remains uninspected.
